units.source_text: 他的正义感渐渐高涨起来，甚至慷慨激昂地说，明天他一定替我向老师解释清楚。

en.t: His sense of justice gradually swelled, and he even declared with passionate indignation that tomorrow he would be sure to explain everything clearly to the teacher on my behalf.

units.source_text: 这时我心中忽地浮现出老师那个刚剃过的、活像刚煮出来的萝卜一样的脑袋，

en.t: At that moment there suddenly rose in my mind the teacher's freshly shaved head, looking exactly like a radish just pulled from the pot,

units.source_text: 然后浮现他那副无抵抗的桃红色的脸颊。

en.t: and then his helpless, peach-pink cheeks appeared as well.

units.source_text: 不知何故，我对这种心象突然感到非常厌恶。

en.t: For some reason, I was suddenly filled with intense disgust at that mental image.

units.source_text: 在鹤川表露正义感之前我必须亲手把它全部埋在土里。

en.t: Before Tsurukawa could display his sense of justice, I had to bury it all in the earth with my own hands.
